headline: Binance Faces Massive Withdrawals Following USD 6.3B Hack
summary: Binance customers have withdrawn billions from their accounts following a USD 6.3 billion hack. Co-founder Yi He stated that ensuring a secure environment and resuming operations are top priorities, while rejecting comparisons to FTX.
why: Binance is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, and major security breaches or liquidity concerns across top platforms can trigger systemic shocks and heightened regulatory scrutiny across the entire digital asset market.

impacts.name: Binance Coin
impacts.why: Massive customer withdrawals and a multi-billion dollar hack directly threaten the platform's solvency and token utility.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A massive security breach and subsequent billions in withdrawals create severe counterparty risk and panic among users, driving down confidence and asset values associated with the exchange.
